title: iOS 1.7 — Email sign-in and honest advisory extents
body:
- Sign in with your email address. Ask for a link from the login screen and tap it to get in — no password to remember.
- Route advisories now tell you how much of the route is actually affected, measured as distance flown rather than a count of forecast points, with a minimum floor so a single flagged point can't read as a long stretch.
- Fewer spurious red convective advisories. Several paths that raised a storm warning for miles the model never actually looked at have been closed.
- More accurate clear-air turbulence. Thresholds now scale with the depth of the layer the turbulence sits in, and the boundary layer is anchored to the model's own terrain rather than sea level.
- Special (SPECI) observations are no longer discarded, so airport conditions reflect the latest report rather than only the routine hourly one.
- Editing a flight's date or route now knows what a Move would discard before it asks you to confirm it.
